text:
lena: FYI a customer followed the Node quickstart and hit a 402 on the very first call. Quickstart wording mentioned trial credits so they were confused.

miri: Can you paste the snippet + workspace id? 402 usually means billing gating.

lena: workspace: rdw-try-2026. curl used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"hi"}'
Response: {"error":{"code":402,"message":"Workspace payment method required: workspace rdw-try-2026"}}

sam: We removed the one-off free-call for production models due to abuse. Quickstart should include a preview-model fallback for onboarding.

miri: Which preview model should we call out? We need something stable and clearly marked for demos.

sam: Recommend "redwood-mini-preview". It's not gated and has a small free allowance suitable for quickstarts. Add an inline example showing how to override the model in the SDK.

jess: UX follow-up: console message "Set payment method" is too terse. I'll file a ticket to add a tooltip: "Production models require a payment method; use redwood-mini-preview for a trial call." Also adding an FAQ entry for CS.

lena: Quick actions for devex: 1) update quickstart readme to show preview fallback + example Node snippet, 2) add a short troubleshooting blurb explaining 402 and the preview workaround, 3) link to console tooltip ticket.

miri: I pushed a tiny docs patch with the preview example and troubleshooting note. Testing now...

lena: Confirmed switching to redwood-mini-preview returns 200 with a simple text output.

devex-bot: Runbook link added to onboarding docs -> https://go/release/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

sam: Good. Let's also add a short CS playbook blurb so reps can explain the change to customers.

jess: Follow-up created for product to consider a product-flag allowing a single ungated sample call for verified org domains; cc @alex-pm.

lena: Closing thread; quickstart PR link in comments.
